fixture.description: Scale fixture, generated by fixtures/generate_large_vault.py with a fixed seed. Tests retrieval quality and compile time, not correctness. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.

performance_budgets.note: Not yet measured. Fill from the first live baseline run, then treat regressions as failures.

retrieval.why: Needle in a haystack. 'Quillion' appears in exactly one note out of 207 and nowhere in the query. Dense retrieval must carry this one; BM25 cannot, since the query shares no rare term with the target.

The same needle by its rare proper noun. BM25 should nail this and dense should struggle, since the token is out of vocabulary for the embedding model. The two queries together are the clearest single argument in the fixture set for hybrid retrieval with rank fusion.
